name: SDF Direct Diffuse Integrator
definition: A differentiable volume rendering integrator that computes direct illumination for SDF-based scenes by combining standard path tracing with a boundary integral term evaluated at grazing points to handle thin surfaces and silhouettes.
summary: The SDF Direct Diffuse Integrator is a differentiable rendering method that computes direct illumination for SDF scenes by incorporating a boundary integral term at grazing points to accurately handle visibility discontinuities.
